# Definition Lists

Add term and definition list syntax to Markdown.

![Definition Lists preview](/assets/plugins/definition-lists/preview.png)

- Plugin ID: `me.kumbuka.definition-lists`
- Source version: `1.0.7`
- Permissions: None

[Source](https://github.com/kumbuka-me/plugins/tree/main/definition-lists) · [Releases](https://github.com/kumbuka-me/plugins/releases?q=definition-lists%2Fv) · [Installation](../../administration/plugins.md)

Definition Lists adds term/definition list syntax to Kumbuka Markdown.

## Usage

```markdown
Runbook
: A repeatable operational procedure.

Owner
: Platform team
```

Definition lists are disabled by default. Enable this plugin when the wiki should recognize this syntax.

## Permissions

This plugin requests no Kumbuka capabilities. It selects Kumbuka's public `definition-list` Markdown grammar.
